title.narrative: Tony Chocolonely Child Labour Monitoring and Remediation System

description.narrative: Tony Chocolonely’s mission is to produce 100% (child) slave-free chocolate. DGGF supply chain finance is used to further develop its supply chain in Ghana and the Ivory Coast where it sources its raw materials from a growing number of local cooperatives and small farmers. Tony’s wants to support and stimulate farmers and other suppliers in the value chain to refrain from of child – and/or slave labour and inspire others to do the same.Technical Assistance through DGGF was provided for the duration of 1 year to set-up and validate a Child Labour Monitoring and Remediation System developed by the International Cocoa Initiative (ICI) in order to reduce slave- and child labour in the Cocao chain in Ghana and the Ivory Coast. The system is based on the presence of community facilitators within cocoa-growing communities who raise awareness on the issue of child labour, identify cases and request remediation actions implemented by ICI together with the company and relevant national agencies. All the information is collected via smartphones and gathered on a data base from which systematic analysis can be conducted and remediation strategies refined.The implementation phase was successful and resulted in 84 local people being trained and employed as Community Facilitators and Monitoring and Remediation Agents for the system. At least 5 cooperatives and 408 farmers were pro-actively engaged on child labour related issues through awareness events during this phase. Furthermore, the results of the validation phase were used to enable sector-wide adaptation of the ICI system.The system is still operational and currently receives support through The Netherlands Enterprise Agency's (RVO) Fund against Child Labour (FBK).
